intro: In 2021 the District of Squamish picked four places to try out off leash dog areas as a pilot. One of them is John Hunter Park in Valleycliffe. The plan was for the Valleycliffe site to be fully fenced.
Three of the four sites are now open: Merrill Park in the Garibaldi Highlands, the Brennan Park dog run, and the Powerline Service Road in Brackendale. John Hunter Park is the one still waiting.

The District says the park needs money spent on fencing before it can open, and it has not set a timeline. The District's newest public update on this is from fall 2024, so the details may have changed since (checked October 2026).

facts.label: Planned design
facts.value: A fully fenced off leash area

facts.label: Status
facts.value: Not open. Needs fencing; no timeline set (District update, fall 2024)

facts.label: Other pilot sites
facts.value: Merrill Park (opened 2022), Brennan Park (opened spring 2024), Powerline Service Road in Brackendale

facts.label: Rules at pilot sites
facts.value: Carry a visible leash, valid dog licence, put waste in a garbage bin

timeline.what: The District surveyed the public on proposed off leash locations. About 860 people commented.
Council voted 4 to 2 to endorse four pilot sites, including John Hunter Park.
The District said sites needing fencing would go forward through the 2023 budget process.
Merrill Park opened as the first off leash pilot area.
The District told the Squamish Chief that John Hunter Park needs fencing and has no opening date because of the added cost.
Brennan Park was open, Brackendale was coming soon, and John Hunter Park still had no timeline.

points: Valleycliffe is the only part of the pilot plan without a working off leash area. Fencing would finish what council endorsed in 2021.
A fence keeps dogs away from the road and from people who don't want contact with dogs, which can make the park easier to share.
A nearby spot means Valleycliffe dog owners don't need to drive across town to let their dog run.
Fencing costs money that could go to other parks or services, and the District has not shown it in a budget.
Fencing off part of the park takes that space away from people who use it for other things.
Some would rather see how the three open sites work before spending more on a fourth.

questions.q: Can I let my dog off leash at John Hunter Park now?
questions.a: No. As of the District's latest update, John Hunter Park has not opened as an off leash area because the fencing has not been built.

questions.q: How much would the fence cost?
questions.a: The District has not published a cost for John Hunter Park. For comparison, staff estimated about $30,000 to fence the Brennan Park dog run in 2021.

questions.q: Why was it not built with the others?
questions.a: The District says this site needs an investment in fencing, and it has not set a timeline.
